definition: Number of recorded interactions for the student before the current interaction.
calculation: Sort by user_id and order_id; within each user_id assign a zero-based cumulative row count.
leakage_and_modeling_notes: Uses only preceding rows and is leakage-safe when ordering is preserved. Measures platform experience rather than skill-specific proficiency.

definition: Minimum number of the student's prior interactions across the Skill_* indicators active on the current row.
calculation: For each user_id and Skill_* column compute cumulative appearances excluding the current row; select active skills on the current row and take their minimum.
leakage_and_modeling_notes: Uses only preceding rows. For a multi-skill row this represents experience with the least-practiced active skill.

definition: Mean number of the student's prior interactions across the Skill_* indicators active on the current row.
calculation: For each user_id and Skill_* column compute cumulative appearances excluding the current row; select active skills on the current row and take their mean.
leakage_and_modeling_notes: Uses only preceding rows. For a single-skill row this is the exact prior count for that skill; for a multi-skill row it averages the active-skill counts.

definition: Median number of the student's prior interactions across the Skill_* indicators active on the current row.
calculation: For each user_id and Skill_* column compute cumulative appearances excluding the current row; select active skills on the current row and take their median.
leakage_and_modeling_notes: Uses only preceding rows. May be fractional for a row with an even number of active skills.

definition: Maximum number of the student's prior interactions across the Skill_* indicators active on the current row.
calculation: For each user_id and Skill_* column compute cumulative appearances excluding the current row; select active skills on the current row and take their maximum.
leakage_and_modeling_notes: Uses only preceding rows. For a multi-skill row this represents experience with the most-practiced active skill.

definition: Indicates that the student has no prior interaction with any Skill_* indicator active on the current row.
calculation: 1 when max_prior_skill_interaction_count equals 0; otherwise 0.
leakage_and_modeling_notes: Uses only preceding rows. On a multi-skill row this equals 1 only when all active skills are new to the student.

definition: Total number of answer attempts made by the student before the current interaction.
calculation: Within each user_id ordered by order_id, cumulatively sum attempt_count and subtract the current row's attempt_count.
leakage_and_modeling_notes: Uses only preceding rows. This is different from prior_interaction_count because an interaction can contain multiple answer attempts.

definition: Number of the student's prior interactions with correct equal to 1.
calculation: Within each user_id ordered by order_id, cumulatively sum correct and subtract the current row's correct value.
leakage_and_modeling_notes: Uses only preceding outcomes. Counts first-attempt successes rather than eventual correctness or total correct answer attempts.

definition: Proportion of the student's prior interactions with correct equal to 1.
calculation: student_prior_correct divided by prior_interaction_count; fill the undefined first-interaction value with 0.
leakage_and_modeling_notes: Uses only preceding outcomes. Range is 0 to 1. A filled 0 with no_prior_history equal to 1 means unavailable history rather than observed zero accuracy.

definition: Mean first-attempt correctness over up to the student's 3 most recent prior interactions.
calculation: Within each user_id, shift correct by one row and take a trailing rolling mean with window 3 and min_periods 1; fill the undefined first-interaction value with 0.
leakage_and_modeling_notes: Uses only preceding outcomes and available history when fewer than 3 prior interactions exist. Use no_prior_history and insufficient_history_3 to distinguish unavailable or incomplete history.

definition: Mean first-attempt correctness over up to the student's 5 most recent prior interactions.
calculation: Within each user_id, shift correct by one row and take a trailing rolling mean with window 5 and min_periods 1; fill the undefined first-interaction value with 0.
leakage_and_modeling_notes: Uses only preceding outcomes and available history when fewer than 5 prior interactions exist. Use no_prior_history and insufficient_history_5 to distinguish unavailable or incomplete history.

definition: Mean first-attempt correctness over up to the student's 10 most recent prior interactions.
calculation: Within each user_id, shift correct by one row and take a trailing rolling mean with window 10 and min_periods 1; fill the undefined first-interaction value with 0.
leakage_and_modeling_notes: Uses only preceding outcomes and available history when fewer than 10 prior interactions exist. Use no_prior_history and insufficient_history_10 to distinguish unavailable or incomplete history.

definition: Number of consecutive correct interactions immediately preceding the current interaction.
calculation: Compute consecutive runs where correct equals 1 within each user_id and shift the completed run length by one row.
leakage_and_modeling_notes: Uses only preceding outcomes. Equals 0 when the immediately preceding interaction was incorrect or when no prior interaction exists.

definition: Number of consecutive incorrect interactions immediately preceding the current interaction.
calculation: Compute consecutive runs where correct equals 0 within each user_id and shift the completed run length by one row.
leakage_and_modeling_notes: Uses only preceding outcomes. Equals 0 when the immediately preceding interaction was correct or when no prior interaction exists.

definition: Indicates that the student has no recorded interaction before the current row.
calculation: 1 when prior_interaction_count equals 0; otherwise 0.
leakage_and_modeling_notes: Leakage-safe because it uses only the count of preceding rows. Distinguishes zero-filled accuracy values caused by absent history from observed zero accuracy.

definition: Indicates that fewer than 3 student interactions precede the current row.
calculation: 1 when prior_interaction_count is less than 3; otherwise 0.
leakage_and_modeling_notes: Leakage-safe. The corresponding recent accuracy still uses all available prior outcomes.

definition: Indicates that fewer than 5 student interactions precede the current row.
calculation: 1 when prior_interaction_count is less than 5; otherwise 0.
leakage_and_modeling_notes: Leakage-safe. The corresponding recent accuracy still uses all available prior outcomes.

definition: Indicates that fewer than 10 student interactions precede the current row.
calculation: 1 when prior_interaction_count is less than 10; otherwise 0.
leakage_and_modeling_notes: Leakage-safe. The corresponding recent accuracy still uses all available prior outcomes.

definition: Minimum total prior answer attempts across the skills active on the current row.
calculation: For each active skill, sum attempt_count over the student's preceding interactions tagged with that skill; take the minimum across active skills.
leakage_and_modeling_notes: Uses only preceding interactions. A multi-skill interaction contributes its attempt_count to each active skill's history.

definition: Mean total prior answer attempts across the skills active on the current row.
calculation: For each active skill, sum attempt_count over the student's preceding interactions tagged with that skill; take the mean across active skills.
leakage_and_modeling_notes: Uses only preceding interactions. A multi-skill interaction contributes its attempt_count to each active skill's history.

definition: Median total prior answer attempts across the skills active on the current row.
calculation: For each active skill, sum attempt_count over the student's preceding interactions tagged with that skill; take the median across active skills.
leakage_and_modeling_notes: Uses only preceding interactions. May be fractional for a row with an even number of active skills.

definition: Maximum total prior answer attempts across the skills active on the current row.

definition: Minimum prior first-attempt accuracy across the skills active on the current row.
calculation: For each active skill, divide the student's prior correct interactions tagged with that skill by prior interactions tagged with that skill; encode unavailable skill history as 0 and take the minimum.
leakage_and_modeling_notes: Uses only preceding outcomes. Prior-skill interaction-count summaries distinguish unavailable history from observed zero accuracy.

definition: Mean prior first-attempt accuracy across the skills active on the current row.

leakage_and_modeling_notes: Uses only preceding outcomes. Prior-skill interaction-count summaries distinguish unavailable history from observed zero accuracy.

definition: Minimum recent accuracy across active skills using up to 3 prior interactions per skill.
calculation: For each active skill, average the student's last 3 or fewer preceding correct outcomes tagged with that skill; encode unavailable history as 0 and take the minimum.
leakage_and_modeling_notes: Uses only preceding outcomes involving the exact skill.
